text:
Marta: quick RFC follow-up — router/executor split proposal. Idea: router handles auth, cheap projections and cached answers; executor handles heavy aggregations, joins, and long-tail work. Opening thread for tradeoffs + rollout plan.

Ajay: What counts as "cheap"? single-row lookups only, or also small group-bys?

Marta: single-row, small index lookups, and tiny prefetches (<100ms). Anything touching multi-tenant joins or >1s expected compute goes to executor.

Sanjeev: we need distinct SLOs and telemetry for both planes. Router target: 95th <100ms, 99th <250ms. Executor: track queue length, processing time, and tenant-impacting tails.

Hao: interface idea — gRPC streaming so router can send partial filters and get streaming rows back. Proto sketch in the prototyping branch. Pros: backpressure and partial success. Cons: ops complexity vs HTTP.

Lexi: migration: feature-flag per-route, start with router-only for cached dashboards. Compare outputs, then flip heavy queries to executor. Need per-route telemetry and correctness checks.

Marta: RBAC: two choices — (A) pushdown token: router evaluates ACL and sends signed token with filters to executor (executor trusts token), (B) double-check: executor re-validates ACL. Pushdown faster but requires cryptographic guarantees.

Ajay: I lean pushdown with signed short-lived tokens including route fingerprint and trace id. For early rollout keep double-check enabled.

Sanjeev: concrete metrics to expose: acl_checks.router, acl_checks.executor, token_rejects, token_age_seconds, router_cpu_ms, executor_queue_depth. Need audit logs if executor sees unsigned/expired tokens.

Hao: also: run executor on a separate node pool to avoid noisy neighbor effects. Router should be CPU-pinned / niceness-raised so routers stay responsive.

Lexi: canary plan: 1) staging correctness; 2) router-only cached routes in prod behind FF; 3) enable signed-token pushdown for a small percent with executor double-check on; 4) after stability, turn off executor double-check; 5) ramp executor-only for heavy routes.

Marta: timeline: 3 weeks prototype (router+signed token), 2 weeks staging bake, 4 weeks phased rollout. I'll update RFC with playbook and checklist.

Ajay: one more perf knob — router_budget_ms per route (default 30ms). If router exceeds it, bail out and forward to executor to avoid hurting small requests.

Marta: expose as per-route config + global cap.

deploy-bot: Marta triggered deploy: "query-router-experiment:v0.1" -> staging at 2024-11-04T18:07:12Z :building_worker:

Hao: I'll upstream a proto and test harness for signed tokens + streaming exec.

Lexi: I'll build telemetry dashboards (SLO, token metrics, per-route p95/p99, error budget).

Marta: sounds good. If nobody objects to signed-token pushdown, I'll author the RFC update and include the rollout checklist. :thumbsup:
